test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the primary purpose of the process of nutrition in living organisms?

options.text: To form oxygen molecules required for photosynthesis
To regulate visible movement and reproduction
To produce carbon dioxide and other waste materials
To obtain energy and raw materials from external sources

solution:
The correct answer is __**To obtain energy and raw materials from external sources**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nutrition** is a fundamental life process that involves the intake of nutrients (food) by an organism and its subsequent utilization for various biological functions.
 
• Living organisms require a continuous supply of **energy** to maintain their **state of order** and perform essential life activities, even when they are not performing any apparent physical work.
 
• Since life on **Earth** is primarily based on **carbon-based molecules**, most food sources are also derived from **carbon**, necessitating the intake of raw materials from the environment.
 
• The process of nutrition ensures that the **raw materials** needed for **growth**, **repair**, and **synthesis of proteins** are made available to the cells. ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• While **oxygen** is involved in the breakdown of food during **respiration**, the primary purpose of nutrition itself is the acquisition of the fuel (food) rather than forming oxygen molecules. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
